Container.Name: nfs-haven-server
Container.Overview: NFS Haven server: one address for the NFS Haven app on Apple TV and Mac. Serves your own copies of the games' data (one folder per game, plus optional mod sets and HD packs) with resumable downloads, keeps every game's saves with version history (shared between Apple TV and Mac), and runs a lobby so network games can be joined over Tailscale.[br][br]Put each game in its own folder of the Games folder: Porsche Unleashed's GameData, FEData, version.txt, fe.txt (and nfs5.exe) go in porsche/original/. Set a Password and enter the same password in the app.[br][br]LAN / Tailscale only: never port-forward this server to the internet.
Container.Requires: Your own copy of each game (for Porsche Unleashed: the GameData and FEData folders).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the app and the status page use.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password the app sends. Enter the same value as the Password in the app: Extras › Network, or the Apple TV Game Data screen. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: One folder per game (read-only): porsche/original/ (the game's own files), porsche/mods/NAME/ (mod sets, overlaid on the original), porsche/hd/ (HD pack). A new game is a new folder.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saves, save versions and caches. Covered by the normal appdata backup.

Config.Name: Save versions
Config.Description: Earlier copies kept per save file (plus one per day for 30 days).

Config.Name: Lobby timeout
Config.Description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a hosted game leaves the lobby.
